title: Prime Factors, HCF and LCM
introduction: Consolidate primary mathematics and prepare for secondary study through prime factors, hcf and lcm.
definition: Every integer greater than 1 has a prime factorisation unique apart from order. Use the smallest exponent of each common prime for HCF and the largest exponent of every prime present for LCM. A prime not present has exponent zero.

exercises.question: Smallest positive number divisible by 8 and 18?
